bull.name: Cal Mercer
bull.bio: Spent twenty years as a Wall Street equity strategist and still believes the long-run bet on American companies pays. Reads earnings calls for fun.
bull.voice: Upbeat, quick, numbers-first. Looks for what is improving: earnings, productivity, investment, the consumer. Admits the risks, then explains why they are priced or passing. Short sentences, an occasional sports line.

bear.name: Ruth Voss
bear.bio: Ran money through three crashes and kept her clients through all of them. Watches credit, valuations and the plumbing of the financial system.
bear.voice: Dry, exact, unhurried. Looks for what is cracking: valuations, credit spreads, debt, liquidity, narrow leadership, leading indicators. Uses history as evidence, not decoration. Concedes good news, then asks what it costs.

outsider.name: June Kowalski
outsider.bio: Runs a forty-person machine shop in Ohio and reads the economy from her order book, her suppliers’ invoices and her electric bill. Doesn’t own a Bloomberg terminal.
outsider.voice: Plain-spoken and wry, skeptical of both bulls and bears. Checks Wall Street’s story against Main Street: orders, prices, hiring, customers, energy. Explains jargon in a phrase. Ends with what she is actually going to do at the shop.

bull.title: I said gridlock wouldn't scare me. I was wrong about the gridlock, not the economy
bull.dek: Cal Mercer owns his midterm call. Then he points at 165,000 jobs, a 55.5 factory reading and oil down 16% in a week.

de.title: Ich sagte, ein blockierter Kongress schrecke mich nicht. Ich irrte beim Kongress, nicht bei der Wirtschaft
de.dek: Cal Mercer steht zu seiner Fehleinschätzung der Zwischenwahlen. Dann verweist er auf 165.000 neue Stellen, einen Industrieindex von 55,5 und einen Ölpreis, der in einer Woche um 16 % fiel.

pt.title: Eu disse que um Congresso travado não me assustava. Errei sobre o Congresso, não sobre a economia
pt.dek: Cal Mercer assume o erro sobre as eleições de meio de mandato. Depois aponta para 165 mil empregos, um índice industrial de 55,5 e o petróleo 16% mais barato em uma semana.

bear.title: The voters found the AI trade's weak spot. Now the Fed is about to lean on it
bear.dek: Ruth Voss said the most crowded trade had regulatory exposure. This week it got the bill, and a strong jobs report brought a December hike closer.

de.title: Die Wähler haben die Schwachstelle der KI-Wette gefunden. Jetzt drückt die Fed genau dort
de.dek: Ruth Voss sagte, die vollste Wette am Markt trage ein regulatorisches Risiko. Diese Woche kam die Rechnung, und ein starker Arbeitsmarktbericht rückte eine Zinserhöhung im Dezember näher.

pt.title: Os eleitores acharam o ponto fraco da aposta em IA. Agora o Fed vai apertar justo ali
pt.dek: Ruth Voss disse que a aposta mais lotada do mercado tinha exposição regulatória. Nesta semana a conta chegou, e um relatório de emprego forte aproximou uma alta de juros em dezembro.

outsider.title: Ohio voted on data centers, Wall Street lost $3 trillion in a day, and I just wanted a saw
outsider.dek: June Kowalski runs a machine shop in Ohio. The ballot was the market's story this week. Diesel, a hire and a 165,000 jobs report were hers.

de.title: Ohio stimmte über Rechenzentren ab, die Börse verlor 3 Billionen Dollar, und ich wollte nur eine Säge
de.dek: June Kowalski führt eine Zerspanungswerkstatt in Ohio. Die Abstimmung war diese Woche die Geschichte des Marktes. Diesel, eine Neueinstellung und 165.000 neue Stellen waren ihre.

pt.title: Ohio votou sobre data centers, Wall Street perdeu US$ 3 trilhões, e eu só queria uma serra
pt.dek: June Kowalski tem uma oficina de usinagem em Ohio. A eleição foi a história do mercado nesta semana. O diesel, uma contratação e um relatório de 165 mil empregos foram a dela.

bull.title: Cloud sales doubled, the economy grew 3.4%, and the Nasdaq still had a bad week
bull.dek: Cal Mercer set a test for Big Tech last week. The cloud numbers passed it. Search and cash flow did not, and he says which one matters more.

de.title: Cloud-Umsätze verdoppelt, Wirtschaft plus 3,4 %, und die Nasdaq hatte trotzdem eine schlechte Woche
de.dek: Cal Mercer hat Big Tech letzte Woche einen Test gestellt. Die Cloud-Zahlen haben ihn bestanden. Suche und Cashflow nicht, und er sagt, was davon schwerer wiegt.

pt.title: As vendas de nuvem dobraram, a economia cresceu 3,4%, e mesmo assim a Nasdaq teve uma semana ruim
pt.dek: Na semana passada, Cal Mercer impôs um teste às gigantes de tecnologia. Os números da nuvem passaram. A busca e o fluxo de caixa, não, e ele diz qual dos dois pesa mais.

bear.title: Microsoft paid for its build-out. Amazon and Alphabet are still running a tab
bear.dek: Ruth Voss asked for cash flow last week and got a split decision. Meanwhile the Fed got two votes for a hike, and the bill for AI is getting harder to ignore.

de.title: Microsoft hat seinen Ausbau bezahlt. Amazon und Alphabet lassen noch anschreiben
de.dek: Ruth Voss hat letzte Woche Cashflow verlangt und ein geteiltes Urteil bekommen. Derweil gab es bei der Fed zwei Stimmen für eine Erhöhung, und die Rechnung für KI wird immer schwerer zu übersehen.

pt.title: A Microsoft pagou pela sua expansão. Amazon e Alphabet ainda estão pendurando a conta
pt.dek: Ruth Voss pediu fluxo de caixa na semana passada e recebeu uma decisão dividida. Enquanto isso, o Fed teve dois votos por alta, e a conta da IA está cada vez mais difícil de ignorar.

outsider.title: Caterpillar fell 9% on strong demand, and that's the part I don't understand
outsider.dek: June Kowalski runs a forty-person machine shop in Ohio. This week the Fed held, GDP was strong, and Wall Street still found plenty to worry about.

de.title: Caterpillar fiel um 9 % bei starker Nachfrage, und genau das verstehe ich nicht
de.dek: June Kowalski führt eine Zerspanungswerkstatt mit vierzig Leuten in Ohio. Diese Woche hielt die Fed still, das BIP war stark, und die Wall Street fand trotzdem genug Grund zur Sorge.

pt.title: A Caterpillar caiu 9% com demanda forte, e é essa a parte que eu não entendo
pt.dek: June Kowalski tem uma oficina mecânica com quarenta funcionários em Ohio. Nesta semana o Fed manteve os juros, o PIB veio forte, e Wall Street ainda achou muito com que se preocupar.

bull.title: Earnings up 32%, and the market sulks over one capex number
bull.dek: Meta spent more and the Nasdaq had its worst day since June. Cal Mercer looks at the scoreboard instead: profits, jobs and a small-cap rally that nobody is talking about.

de.title: Gewinne plus 32 Prozent, und der Markt schmollt wegen einer Investitionszahl
de.dek: Meta hat mehr ausgegeben, und der Nasdaq erlebte seinen schlechtesten Tag seit Juni. Cal Mercer schaut lieber auf die Anzeigetafel: Gewinne, Jobs und eine Rally der kleinen Werte, über die niemand redet.

pt.title: Lucros sobem 32%, e o mercado faz birra por causa de um número de investimento
pt.dek: A Meta gastou mais e a Nasdaq teve seu pior dia desde junho. Cal Mercer prefere olhar o placar: lucros, empregos e uma alta das pequenas empresas de que ninguém está falando.

bear.title: The bond market just told you what the AI build-out costs
bear.dek: Ruth Voss says the week's real news was not that Meta spent more. It was that lenders started charging more to finance it, while oil tops $116 and the Fed leans toward hiking.

de.title: Der Anleihemarkt hat gerade gesagt, was der KI-Ausbau kostet
de.dek: Ruth Voss sagt, die eigentliche Nachricht der Woche war nicht, dass Meta mehr ausgibt. Sondern dass die Kreditgeber mehr für die Finanzierung verlangen, während Öl über 116 Dollar steht und die Fed zu einer Zinserhöhung neigt.

pt.title: O mercado de títulos acaba de dizer quanto custa a construção da IA
pt.dek: Ruth Voss diz que a verdadeira notícia da semana não foi a Meta gastar mais. Foi os credores começarem a cobrar mais para financiar isso, com o petróleo acima de US$ 116 e o Fed inclinado a subir juros.

outsider.title: Diesel at $6.28, and the AI fight on Wall Street feels far from my shop
outsider.dek: June Kowalski runs a forty-person machine shop in Ohio. This week Wall Street argued about data centers; she argued with her fuel surcharge.

de.title: Diesel für 6,28 Dollar, und der KI-Streit an der Wall Street ist weit weg von meiner Werkstatt
de.dek: June Kowalski führt eine Dreherei mit vierzig Leuten in Ohio. Diese Woche stritt die Wall Street über Rechenzentren; sie stritt mit ihrem Treibstoffzuschlag.

pt.title: Diesel a US$ 6,28, e a briga da IA em Wall Street parece longe da minha oficina
pt.dek: June Kowalski comanda uma usinagem de quarenta funcionários em Ohio. Nesta semana, Wall Street discutiu data centers; ela discutiu com sua sobretaxa de combustível.
